objective: Test whether exchange-specific informed-flow shocks and transient fair-value disagreement create executable single-leg Binance USD-M BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT alpha after actual quote, latency, fee and impact costs.

economic_logic.smc_ict_translation: An external-liquidity run is accepted only when the initiating venue shows aggressive-flow persistence and quote depletion; a sweep/rejection is accepted only after the initiating flow decays or reverses and the target venue replenishes against the move. Fair value is cross-venue and point-in-time, not a retrospectively painted chart level.
economic_logic.microstructure: Perpetual markets share the same underlying but receive information and forced inventory asynchronously. The target venue can briefly lag a price-discovering venue, or overshoot after consuming local liquidity. The edge must exceed the target venue's observed spread, fee, latency and size-dependent impact.
economic_logic.why_distinct: This is tick/quote cross-exchange propagation, not Binance spot-perp leadership, five-minute cross-asset lead-lag, exact funding settlement, OI, single-venue L1 routing or candlestick pattern research.

sources.source_identity: Every downloaded gzip is recorded by canonical URL, response headers, bytes and SHA-256. Missing or schema-incompatible files cause a closed failure, not imputation.
sources.upgrade_rule: A passing sample study must be reproduced on official venue archives or a separately registered full tick dataset before promotion.

time_splits.development_days: UTC first calendar day of every month from 2022-01 through 2023-12
time_splits.selection_days: UTC first calendar day of every month in 2024, physically unopened until the development gate passes
time_splits.confirmation_days: UTC first calendar day of every month in 2025, physically unopened until a single frozen 2024 primary passes

information_availability.event_clock: exchange timestamp with local timestamp used only for latency diagnostics
information_availability.signal: only trades and quotes observed at or before decision timestamp
information_availability.entry: first Binance quote at or after decision timestamp plus preregistered latency
information_availability.exit: first Binance quote satisfying a causal exit condition or the first quote at/after maximum horizon
information_availability.simultaneous_timestamp_policy: target quote must have an exchange timestamp no earlier than the final signal event; ties are resolved by file sequence and then adverse execution

families.bybit_to_binance_propagation: Bybit aggressive-flow and mid-price impulse persists while Binance has realized only a bounded fraction of the cross-venue move and its own flow does not contradict it; trade Binance toward the Bybit-implied fair value.
families.binance_overshoot_fade: Binance moves beyond the contemporaneous Bybit fair-value response after Binance flow decays or flips; trade Binance back toward the cross-venue fair value.
families.simultaneous_shock_basis_snapback: Both venues move in one direction but the Binance-Bybit executable basis becomes extreme; enter only after the basis has begun to contract and local flow no longer supports widening.

portfolio_and_execution.entry_and_exit: marketable using observed bid/ask plus size-dependent adverse impact; no mid-price fills
portfolio_and_execution.funding: not material for ten-second maximum holds; any settlement timestamp collision blocks entry rather than assuming favorable ordering

development_gate.diversity_before_rank: preserve one representative per family and latency bucket before filling by robust score

confirmation_gate.target_test_after_everything_frozen: external-cashflow-adjusted net geometric daily NAV return >= 0.01

prohibitions: No selection or confirmation URL request before its preceding frozen gate passes.
No target-return, leverage, latency or fee fitting.
No favorable use of same-timestamp event ordering.
No paper, testnet or live orders.
No Champion proposal from public sample days alone.
